text: How the hell did you find me?! I ain't comin' back!
zh: 你到底是怎么找到我的？！我是不会回去的！

text: Hol' on... You ain't a bandit, right?
zh: 等等……你不是强盗，对吧？

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: What are you doing here?
zh: 你在这里做什么？

text: How long have you been here?
zh: 你在这里待多久了？

text: What is at the end of the mountain path?
zh: 山路的尽头有什么？

text: Aren't you afraid that the bandits will find you here?
zh: 你不怕强盗找到这儿来吗？

text: In which mine did you work?
zh: 你以前在哪座矿里干活？

text: Do you have some ore to sell?
zh: 你有矿石要卖吗？

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: Those bastards got me working in the mine!
zh: 那帮混蛋逼我在矿里干活！

text: Just don't tell anyone that you saw me.
zh: 千万别告诉任何人你见过我。

text: But I didn't care to do that my whole life, you know?
zh: 但我可不想一辈子都干那个，你懂吗？

text: As soon as they looked away, I took my chance and ran.
zh: 他们一不留神，我就抓住机会跑了。

text: Eventually, I found this cave.
zh: 最后，我找到了这个洞穴。

text: What do I know?
zh: 我哪儿知道？

text: Could be a while already, I guess.
zh: 估计已经有一阵子了吧。

text: You again? What do you want?
zh: 又是你？你想干什么？

text: Pretty cozy place, don't you think?
zh: 这地方挺舒坦的，你说是不是？

text: Lose track of time in here after a while.
zh: 在这里待久了，时间都数不清了。

text: Don't you know?
zh: 你不知道吗？

text: Goran and his bandits are up there.
zh: 戈兰和他的强盗就在上面。

text:
One of those bandits?
Hah, I don't think so.
zh:
怕那帮强盗？
哈，我看不至于。

text: I can hear those blundering fools from miles away, haha!
zh: 那帮笨手笨脚的蠢货，隔着几里地我都能听见，哈哈！

text: Even if one of them finds me, I still have some ore lying around to bribe them.
zh: 就算真有人找到我，我手头还存着些矿石，可以拿去买通他们。

text:
Sure!
I had a good yield lately.
zh:
当然有！
我最近收成不错。

text: Me?
zh: 我？

text:
I am #:Albert:#!
I once was a digger, but now I am just an old man.
zh:
我是#:阿尔伯特:#！
我曾经是个挖矿的，如今只是个老头子了。

text: The mine south of here. Heard it was closed off a while ago.
zh: 南边那座矿。听说前阵子已经封了。

text: Not that I care about it.
zh: 反正我也不关心。

text:
Honestly, it was a weird place anyway.
Sometimes in the mine, I heard noises behind the walls in the room where we stored our supplies.
zh:
说实话，那地方本来就透着古怪。
有时候在矿里，我能听见存放补给的屋子的墙后面有动静。
